# googleads_callout_asset (Resource)

A callout asset — a short non-clickable phrase shown under a search ad (e.g. "Free shipping", "24/7 support"). Asset content is immutable; only the wrapper's `name` can be renamed. **The API has no remove operation** — to stop managing, unlink, remove from HCL, then `terraform state rm`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleads_callout_asset" "free_shipping" {
  customer_id  = "1234567890"
  callout_text = "Free shipping over $50"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `callout_text` (String) The callout text (1–25 characters). Immutable.
- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Optional display name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Asset resource name.
